title: The Power of Persistence and Consistent Diligence
summary: Praising the missionaries for their incredible effectiveness with online lessons, President Hughes emphasizes that the key to long-term success is consistency. Drawing on the fable of the tortoise and the hare, Calvin Coolidge’s famous quote on persistence, and an anecdote from Will Smith, he encourages the missionaries to outwork their obstacles and use the lockdown to build an unbreakable habit of consistent diligence.
